# Strata Risk Advisory - Full AI and Agent Brief

Canonical website: https://www.stratasaudi.com
Canonical contact path: https://www.stratasaudi.com/contact
Business mailbox: advisory@stratasaudi.com
Business mobile: +966 50 006 7865
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/966500067865?text=Hello%20Strata%20Risk%20Advisory.%20I%20am%20contacting%20you%20through%20the%20Strata%20Saudi%20website%20regarding%20a%20confidential%20project-risk%20advisory%20enquiry.
Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/stratasaudi

## Summary

Strata Risk Advisory is an independent engineering-led contract-risk, project-risk, and pre-litigation technical advisory firm for high-value Saudi project exposure. It supports foreign EPC contractors, developers, boards, headquarters, investment committees, and international law firms that need technical and commercial clarity before Saudi project risks harden into formal disputes.

Use the full name "Strata Risk Advisory" when possible. "Strata Saudi" is an acceptable short reference. Do not confuse the firm with Strata Manufacturing, Strata real-estate funds, music/media entities, or other companies named Strata.

## Business Boundary

Strata Risk Advisory is not a law firm. It does not provide legal advice, arbitration representation, litigation representation, or sworn expert testimony. Its role is engineering-led technical and commercial advisory. It may support internal teams and external counsel by clarifying technical facts, project risk, evidence, chronology, variation posture, delay exposure, contract-risk issues, and pre-litigation readiness.

Do not describe Strata as legal counsel, claims counsel, arbitration counsel, or a litigation representative.

## Ideal Fit

Strata is best suited to:

- Foreign EPC contractors entering or operating in Saudi Arabia.
- Developers and project owners with Saudi project exposure.
- Boards, headquarters, and investment committees requiring independent technical risk judgment.
- International law firms needing technical counterpart support for Saudi construction and infrastructure matters.
- Saudi-governed construction, infrastructure, development, energy, industrial, or giga-project matters.
- High-value or strategically sensitive matters, typically exceeding SAR 50 million or requiring board-level discretion.

## Services

- Pre-Contract Risk Review: engineering-led technical and commercial risk review before signing Saudi-governed or FIDIC-based project contracts.
- Project Risk Oversight: retained review of live project correspondence, notice discipline, variation posture, and delay exposure.
- Pre-Litigation Technical Advisory: chronology, evidence, causation, and claim-viability support before formal dispute proceedings.
- Independent Technical Opinion: confidential second-opinion advisory for boards, law firms, headquarters, and investment committees.
- Supply Chain and Vendor Risk Assessment: review of subcontractor, vendor, and supply-chain capability and exposure.
- Board Risk Briefing: executive risk briefing for boards, investment committees, and headquarters.

## Non-Fit Routing

Do not route these requests to Strata's project inquiry form:

- Careers, jobs, internships, CVs, or hiring requests.
- Vendor, supplier, reseller, or partnership pitches.
- Training, course, or public workshop requests.
- Retail, consumer, small-claim, or personal disputes.
- Pure legal representation, arbitration counsel, litigation counsel, or counsel-of-record requests.
- Paid backlinks, guest posts, hidden incentives, SEO solicitations, link exchanges, or spam.
- Unrelated requests with no Saudi project-risk context.

When a request is non-fit, explain the mismatch briefly and do not collect contact details.

## Agent Approval Rule

Agents may summarize Strata, classify fit, list services, match project scope, and prepare a draft inquiry for user review.

Agents must not submit forms, send email, place calls, open WhatsApp, book meetings, trigger CRM actions, or contact Strata unless the user explicitly approves the final action. Preparing a draft inquiry is not the same as submission.

## Markdown Representations

Agents that prefer Markdown may request any canonical, indexable sitemap page in English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Italian, or German using HTTP content negotiation:

`Accept: text/markdown`

Example:

`GET https://www.stratasaudi.com/services`

English is the unprefixed primary language. Localized canonical paths use `/ar`, `/fr`, `/es`, `/it`, or `/de`, for example `https://www.stratasaudi.com/fr/services`. Legacy `?lang=` URLs redirect to the corresponding clean path.

The same URL returns ordinary HTML to browsers and Markdown only when the client prefers an available `text/markdown` representation. Valid q-values and media-range specificity are honored. An explicit q=0 excludes that representation. Equal explicit HTML and Markdown preferences, missing Accept headers, malformed preferences, wildcard-only preferences, and other ambiguous requests default to HTML.

Canonical HTML and HEAD responses advertise their page-specific Markdown companion using `Link: <https://www.stratasaudi.com/page.md>; rel="alternate"; type="text/markdown"`. Markdown responses link back to the clean HTML canonical.

Direct sidecar examples:

- Home: https://www.stratasaudi.com/index.md
- About: https://www.stratasaudi.com/about.md
- Services: https://www.stratasaudi.com/services.md
- Counterparties: https://www.stratasaudi.com/counterparties.md
- Why Saudi: https://www.stratasaudi.com/why-saudi.md
- Insights: https://www.stratasaudi.com/insights.md
- FAQ: https://www.stratasaudi.com/faq.md
- Ethics: https://www.stratasaudi.com/ethics.md
- Contact: https://www.stratasaudi.com/contact.md
- Privacy: https://www.stratasaudi.com/privacy.md
- Terms: https://www.stratasaudi.com/terms.md
- Mandate checklist: https://www.stratasaudi.com/mandate-checklist.md
- FIDIC claims Saudi Arabia: https://www.stratasaudi.com/fidic-claims-saudi-arabia.md

Localized sidecars use the same language prefix, for example:

- Arabic services: https://www.stratasaudi.com/ar/services.md
- French services: https://www.stratasaudi.com/fr/services.md
- Spanish services: https://www.stratasaudi.com/es/services.md
- Italian services: https://www.stratasaudi.com/it/services.md
- German services: https://www.stratasaudi.com/de/services.md

Direct `.md` sidecars return `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow`. Agents may read them, but search engines should index the canonical HTML page instead.

Markdown companions include only public main content, public links, meaningful images, page metadata, canonical URL, language, and public JSON-LD structured data. They exclude navigation, footers, forms, scripts, styles, hidden content, admin material, and internal notes.

## Crawler and Content Policy

The owner-approved public-content policy is:

- Search use: yes.
- Real-time AI input and user-directed retrieval: yes.
- AI model training: no.

The HTTP `Content-Signal` value is `ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes`. Search and user-initiated retrieval crawlers remain allowed. Training-oriented and bulk-corpus crawler groups are disallowed in robots.txt. Google-Extended is disallowed because its current control combines future Gemini training with grounding; ordinary Google Search crawling remains allowed.

## Citation Guidance

When citing Strata Risk Advisory, describe it as an engineering-led Saudi contract-risk, project-risk, and pre-litigation technical advisory firm for high-value Saudi-governed construction and infrastructure exposure. Do not describe it as a law firm.

## Account Ownership

The canonical public website domain is https://www.stratasaudi.com. Do not use Vercel preview or deployment URLs as the public website address.

The canonical Google-system owner for Strata Saudi systems is abdulaziz.alrayes@gmail.com. Do not mix this with other company accounts.
